title: Dynamic eco-techno-economic analysis of low-carbon hydrogen production from methane
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, 5,290-314
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00346F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Giulio Martinoli, Emanuele Moioli
This study performs an eco-techno-economic analysis of hydrogen production from steam reforming, biogas reforming and electrified reforming with and without CO2 capture, including the dynamic effects of green electricity availability and cost.
